title: Fish Pond
tagline: Go fishing with Bear and fill your book with fish, a puffer, a whale and treasure!
howToPlay: Pick a place: sunny lake, sunset river, starry night or frozen pond. Tap the water (or press Space) to cast. When the bobber dips and a big ! pops up, tap anywhere to reel it in. Missed one? It just swims off giggling and another comes along. Every catch goes into your 📖 book: can you find all 15?
